description: eENVPLUS Flood Probability Map is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eenvplus.sinergis.it. This is the Flood Probability Map data elaborated by the eENVplus EP09 geohazard widget and based on the Flood prone area model defined by GeoZS Slovenian Geological Survey and ISPRA Geological Survey of Italy.This data are a selection part of potential map elaborated by the tool. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include eenvplus, ep09, egdi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
